define <2 x double> @vfmax_vv_v2f64_unmasked(<2 x double> %va, <2 x double> %vb, i32 zeroext %evl) {

  store i32 poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %B = add i32 %evl, 0
  %v = call <2 x double> @llvm.maxnum.v2f64(<2 x double> %va, <2 x double> %vb)
